topics.title: Jardiance (Empagliflozin) Post-Approval Clinical Studies (HFrEF 1245-0291, HFpEF 1245-0313) — CDE Feedback on Delayed Reporting

background.text: Two China local NIS post-approval studies for HFrEF (1245-0291, Nov 2021–Q1 2026) and HFpEF (1245-0313, Q4 2022–Q1 2026) face enrollment delay due to VBP and drug switch situation. HAI was sent on Jan 20th asking CDE whether BI could delay submission of complete post-approval clinical study reports to next re-registration application (planned 2031).
background.quote:
Current database enrolment delay: due to VBP, and drug switch situation
HAI was sent on Jan 20th,  waiting for CDE’s feedback

background.text: CDE feedback received 14 May: suggests submitting periodical analytical reports of the two post-approval clinical trials; if any serious safety issue identified, should submit relevant report in time.
background.quote:
CDE feedback received at 14 May:
     建议两项上市后临床研究过程中适时提交阶段性分析报告，如有严重安全性问等，应及时提交报告。
